0022600176.text: The Brooklyn Nets (1-6, 15th in the East, 5th in the Atlantic and 5.5 games back) host the Charlotte Hornets (3-5, 9th in the East, 3rd in the Southeast and 1.5 games back), with Brooklyn on a six-game losing skid and 0-3 at home while Charlotte has dropped four straight. Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), both out, while Charlotte is without Grant Williams (hamstring, out) and has Coby White listed as day-to-day with a calf issue and a game-time decision. The Nets trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 110-103 home loss to Charlotte on October 21, and lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
